description: This PHP script manages issue tracker editing within the TestLink project. It initializes page parameters, handles user actions such as create, edit, delete, and manages the rendering of GUI templates or redirections based on user actions and permissions.

methods.name: renderGui
methods.description: Handles the rendering of the issue tracker GUI, either by template display or by redirect based on the action performed.

methods.name: initScript
methods.description: Initializes the script by setting up arguments, GUI state, and command manager.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Processes request parameters, sanitizes input via a whitelist, and returns an object with the script arguments.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI state, including user permissions and test project links based on the current issue tracker entry.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies whether the current user has permissions to manage issue trackers.
